title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise
summary: Chat and Cowork are now unified into one Claude experience across web, desktop, and mobile, and this is generally available for Enterprise plans. Users don't pick a mode up front: a chat continues as agentic work in the cloud when a task needs code or files, and tasks keep running after the laptop closes and can resume across devices. Admins get role-based access, a new Efficient mode limited to Sonnet and Haiku, and spend controls per org, group, and member, with SSO and Compliance API controls carrying over.

title: Claude Security now scans continuously and tracks fixes
summary: Claude Security is in public beta for Enterprise, powered by Claude models including Claude Mythos, and connects to repos via a GitHub app or tokens for a baseline scan followed by risk-based rescans. It marks findings fixed when code lands and reopens them automatically if the issue reappears, with a per-project knowledge base, an editable threat model, and severity and attacker-reachability details. A new API, MCP connector, webhooks, and role-based access controls round out the release.

title: Introducing Claude Duet
summary: Claude Duet is a research-preview proactive agent app for iOS, Android, and claude.ai that sends a morning brief, checks connected apps every few hours, and works in the background on its own VM. It asks for approval before sending, paying, signing, or deleting, and some actions such as trading or moving money are off-limits. It draws on 6,000+ connectors and plugins in the Claude Marketplace, is available by waitlist starting with US Pro and Max subscribers, and shares usage limits with Claude.

title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
summary: Anthropic explains the safeguards for Claude Duet, a research-preview cloud-computer agent that uses connected apps, where sensitive actions like sending, paying, or deleting require user approval showing the details. An outgoing-message classifier blocks credentials and government IDs, health and financial data is shared only with consent, and Duet never sees passwords, cookies, or tokens because its browser runs in a separate VM. Anthropic also acknowledges the risk of approval fatigue and that its safeguards can miss things.

title: HCLTech joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier partner
summary: HCLTech, with more than 230,000 employees across 60 countries, becomes a Global Premier partner and will build agentic solutions through a dedicated Anthropic business unit and center of excellence. It embeds Claude in HCL BigFix, AppScan, and Actian AI analyst, and adds Claude and Claude Code to its AI Force platform, with client sandboxes and engineer oversight of high-impact changes. The partnership targets regulated sectors such as banking, healthcare, telecom, and manufacturing, and HCLSoftware becomes an ISV partner.

title: How an Anthropic Japan business development representative runs his day with Claude Managed Agents
summary: An Anthropic business development representative in Japan runs six agents, collectively called Nakama, on Claude Managed Agents for lead routing, emails, CRM updates, and meeting follow-ups, with Claude Tag handling Slack follow-ups. The agents run on schedules, share a memory store, use scoped credential vaults, and rely on cheaper models for rule-based jobs and a larger model for judgment work. He reports about 60 hours saved per week, built without being a developer, and recommends one job per agent, a shared knowledge base for corrections, and matching model size to task difficulty.
